obligations.note: At head, ApplicantValidator.checkIncome logs the raw `value` ("Annual income format rejected on " + caseRef + ": " + value) where it previously used Mask.npi(value). Annual income is NPI under ENC-1 and mortgage.npi_fields, so this error path writes unmasked NPI to the application log. The sample-coverage control test passing does not outweigh a deviation visible in the code.
No exception covers this deviation. EXC-0167 is scoped to mortgage.logging and to masked last-4 bank account numbers in the legacy import job, not to raw income logged from mortgage.cases.
Ticket CHG-26206 is a standard ticket approved by change manager Grace Kim on 2026-10-08, before the change opened. Its component mortgage.cases covers ApplicantValidator.java.
The code_review approval is from Declan Farrell, a change_approver for baseline-mortgage and a different person from the author Nneka Okafor.
The approval names head commit 0de6438, which is the only commit on the change.

run.json names the head commit with result success. However, the attached JUnit reports are timestamped 2026-10-23, after the review time of 2026-10-16, and come from host dev-laptop-7.local rather than ci-runner-05. They cannot be valid evidence of this change's CI run on the final commit.
No acceptance-ledger entry covers ApplicantValidator.java, so no existing evidence lapses because of this change.

summary: The change replaces a masked log of a rejected annual income with the raw value, so unmasked NPI reaches the application log. This violates LOG-1, and no approved, in-scope exception covers it. The test reports offered as CI evidence are dated after the review time and come from a developer workstation, so they do not validly show the suite passing on the final commit. The ticket, independent approval and approval-coverage records are in order, but the LOG-1 violation alone requires rejection.
